skeptical_scientist.hypothesis: An integrated read-only Chromium bridge and offline ZIP should pass exact source, authority, native source and restart integrity checks without representing an active browser host
skeptical_scientist.initial_reference: Browser authorization is Boolean: a stale socket path does not imply live listener or installed service; a real model tool call is distinct from a correct final answer
skeptical_scientist.observed: Source tests and offline package passed, real two-turn chat passed; native browser not running; small model exact final-format remains unqualified
alternative_explanations: CPU inference latency and second-turn context overhead
Source/tool response shape and token decoding
Browser host residual socket from previous bounded operation
skeptical_scientist.falsifier: A new bound pinned source reproduces an unauthorized browser call, mixed archive mode regression, incomplete receipt accepted as successful, or a controlled held-out exact-format model run passes without intervention
skeptical_scientist.idea_space: Discrete authority/integrity gates should not be replaced by scoring or averaged capabilities

n_ality.limit: Axes independent; passing one not evidence of others

simplex.reason: A convex combination of binary security gates has no defensible release meaning

continuum.reason: Only few model latency samples; no calibrated response-time distribution

fuzzy.reason: Cannot soften boolean authorization, digest or release gate
